man cannot independently liquidate his existence and draw
up his accounts. And although we have surrendered this
thought to-day we have not been able to get rid of the
implied fear. The fact that man will not speak of death
and equip himself to meet it, shows only that he is afraid
and is tensely closing his eyes in the face of this ultimate
mystery.
Which of us to-day would think of growing angry when
in a given case the approach of death was studiously con-
cealed from a sick person? And who would take it upon
himself to tell an unsuspecting person that he must soon die?
But this only shows what we have at length come to, and how
carefully we have concealed from ourselves the fundamental
insecurity of our life; how little we take seriously the idea:
"in Him we live and move and have our being". For the
Lord of heaven and earth is also the Lord of life and death:
and the thought "in Him we live and move and have our
being" implies also media in vita in morte sumus (in the midst
of life we are in death.
Thus the resources of technics do not suffice to make man
master of death, nor of God. In fact he does not even thereby
become master of himself, but only falls into the danger of
losing his own. One of the means by which technics has
influenced the human mind so seductively is its power of
increasingly overcoming the boundaries of space and time,
and thus of making the original limits, which reminded man
forcibly of his finitude, shrink more and more, or at least
appear to shrink; for the fact is that man never escapes these
limits. But the less he feels them, so much the more he
forgets all about them and forgets at the same time his
finitude; so much the more riotously self-secure become his
plans and calculations. In proportion as this happens, the
hurry and fret of his life grow and the less time remains to
him for consideration and reflection. Modern man who is
swept away by the rush of life, which modern technology
governs, only attains an acute awareness of time in those
periods when his time is not filled by any specific content.
